models.name: Майя
models.notes: The upstream README explicitly licenses mpfb.glb under CC0. The model was created with Blender and MPFB/MakeHuman and contains 52 ARKit face shapes plus 14 non-silent Oculus visemes. Local runtime copy was losslessly structure-preserved and compressed with glTF-Transform 4.4.1 using Meshopt and WebP; all 66 named facial morph targets remain present. Runtime binary stays local and is not committed.
